description: What could go wrong buying a token, by contract address, on Solana, Robinhood Chain, HyperEVM, Base, Ethereum or Arbitrum. Solana: whether someone can still mint more or freeze holders, Token-2022 traps (transfer fees, a permanent delegate, transfer hooks), and how concentrated the top holders are. EVM: buy and sell taxes and whether the contract still has an owner. Both: a $100 buy-then-sell test through the router (can you sell it, and what's lost). Returns a verdict (high, caution or low) and the reasons. Not a guarantee.

address.description: The token's contract address (0x...) or Solana mint

chain.description: Default robinhood for 0x addresses, solana for mints
